note: 201/2-03's unanswered half, taken 2026-08-30 through the phone console's MCP channel (no person relayed a number). The 2026-08-23 row could not price a frame because render-on-demand left it idle-dominated; this window was DRIVEN — the camera was flown across the pinned district by an agent (six poses, heights 260-1400, both tilts and headings) while the collector ran. It is still a MIXED window and must be read as one: of 1406 frames, 904 sit in the >=100 ms bin (the idle poll of 201/4-01's render gate, plus one 18.2 s gap where Android froze the backgrounded tab), and 503 are moving frames. The moving half is what a frame COSTS and it is derived from the histogram, not from the report's own dtP50/dtP95 — those average the idle poll in and read 100.4/106.0 ms, which is not a frame cost. Derived over the 503 moving frames: p50 30 ms (33 fps), p90 64, p95 66 (15 fps), p99 86. The shape is a VSYNC LADDER rather than a spread: 189 frames (38%) land on one 16.7 ms interval, 152 (30%) on two, 108 (21%) on three, 40 (8%) on four. So the console DOES reach 60 fps on this device and holds it for a third of the driven frames; what it does not do is hold it - the p95 is four intervals. Largest CPU item is overlay-2d at 2.37 ms mean against engine-frame's 0.57, which reproduces 201/1-01's finding at 150 units and is 5/02's business rather than the profile's. GPU time is not measurable on this adapter (no timestamp-query). Not comparable with any desktop row. Device MGA-LX3 / ARM Bifrost, 360x570 CSS at DPR 2 (the surface grew mid-run when the browser chrome collapsed - see the target figure). App 311f2d1, which PREDATES 201/7-10, so no Mark43 verdict rides on this row. Pak: original, rect 5,-7,6,-6, textures astc, models=true, bake-collision=true, built 19:23 28-08-2026.
